    chosen_character = random.choice([characters[random.randint(0, 4)]])
    chosen_plot_element = chosen_plot + chosen_character
    return chosen_plot_element

import random

def make_sentence():
    nouns = ["cat", "tree", "sunshine", "snowflake"]
    verb = ["slept", "watched", "jumped"]
    adjective = ["soft", "shiny", "magical"]

    noun_index = random.randint(0, len(nouns))
    verb_index = random.randint(0, len(verb))
    adjective_index = random.randint(0, len(adjective))

    sentence = f"{noun_index}: {nouns[noun_index]}" 
    sentence += f" {verb_index}: {verb[verb_index]}" 
    sentence += f"  {adjective_index}: {adjective[adjective_index]}" 
    sentence += f"]()"
    return sentence
```
